header.title: Delivery
header.description: Do we deliver on time, and where does work wait?
header.scope: Oct–2 Nov 2026 vs 1–2 Aug 2026 · Whole agency · 5 people

kpis.label: On-time delivery
kpis.no_change_reason: No figure for 1–2 Aug 2026: no task with a due date reached Approved

info.name: On-time delivery
info.definition: Tasks that reached Approved in the period with a due date, and were finished on or before it, as a share of all of them.
info.formula: on time ÷ approved with a due date

kpis.label: Overdue

change.tooltip: Was 0 tasks in 1–2 Aug 2026 · 1–2 Aug 2026 is the part of the period recorded: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Overdue
info.definition: Open tasks (neither Approved nor Closed) past their due date at the end of the period.
info.formula: count of open tasks with due date < period end
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

kpis.sub: Open and past their due date

kpis.label: Cycle time
kpis.no_change_reason: No figure for 1–2 Aug 2026: no task reached Approved

info.name: Cycle time
info.definition: Working days a task spends from its first In progress to Approved -- in In progress, In review and client review -- over the tasks approved in the period, from the trail of their statuses. A task with no trail is left out and counted.
info.formula: Σ working days in those statuses ÷ approved tasks with a trail

kpis.sub: 20 of 20 approved tasks have a record of their stages

kpis.label: Send-backs per approved task
kpis.no_change_reason: No figure for 1–2 Aug 2026: no task reached Approved

info.name: Send-backs per approved task
info.definition: The send-backs that happened in the period -- a task moved from either review status back to In progress -- for each task approved in the period.
info.formula: send-backs in the period ÷ tasks approved in the period

kpis.label: Waiting on the client
kpis.reason: No approved task went through Client review

info.name: Waiting on the client
info.definition: Working days approved tasks spent in client review, over the ones that went through it.
info.formula: Σ working days in that status ÷ tasks that went through it
